days.title: Industrial Engineering and UNESCO Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: ponte di ferro di Paderno - Calusco
stops.detail: Among the civil engineering works, the iron bridge of Paderno - Calusco is noteworthy.

stops.name: Crespi d'Adda
stops.detail: For industrial archaeology, an example of urban planning linked to 19th-century industrialization is the workers' village of Crespi d'Adda, now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

stops.name: Centrale idroelettrica Semenza
stops.detail: Also noteworthy are the four historic hydroelectric power stations on the Adda; starting from the north we find: the Semenza hydroelectric power station in Calusco d'Adda (Bg), the Bertini and Esterle stations both in Porto di Cornate d'Adda (Mb) and finally the Taccani in Trezzo sull'Adda, (Mi).

stops.name: chiuse di Leonardo
stops.detail: Within the park there are interesting examples of 19th-century hydraulic engineering, including the canals and Leonardo's locks in Trezzo.

stops.name: ecomuseo di Leonardo
stops.detail: The Leonardo ecomuseum has been set up inside it.
